thread:
nina: FYI a customer reported a confusing console flow: they created a key under an org SA but expected project quotas to apply. reproduced locally. seems tied to a slow project lookup.
tim: can you paste the minimal repro?
nina: sure. flow: Console -> SA -> Create key (select project quickly) but if the project lookup RPC takes >2s, backend falls back to org-create. payload: 
```
POST /v1/keys
{
  "sa": "sa:payments",
  "org": "org:acme",
  "project": "proj:stripe-integration",
  "scopes": ["inference.generate"]
}
```
nina: server logs show project-lookup 504 then key-service write with project_id=null.
kevin: that's bad UX. billing and quota teams see org keys as 'global' and they get counted differently. we need to make the console distinguish the flows.
sara: telemetry proposal: emit event key.create.outcome with tags { project_resolved: true|false, proxy_status: 2xx/5xx, init_path: console/api }. sample 1% and backfill for historical spikes.
tim: engineering proposal: two changes: (1) API should return header X-Key-Create-Reason with values like "ok", "fallback_org_timeout", "explicit_org_request". (2) Console should show a non-dismissable inline notice when reason!=ok and make users confirm.
nina: I prefer a modal for now so customers explicitly acknowledge that quotas/billing may differ. modal text draft: "We couldn't confirm the project context due to an identity service timeout. The key was created at the org level and may bypass project quotas. Convert to a project key if you intended project-level controls." add convert button.\e kevin: (typo) kevin: also we should surface the event in the keys dashboard and add a filter "projectless" so support can quickly find these.
sara: rollout: feature-flag the header as auth.key_reason and enable in staging first. add dashboard panel: projectless keys per hour, and correlation line with auth-proxy latency P95. alert if projectless_rate > 0.3% over 1h.
tim: convert endpoint discussion: we can add POST /v1/keys/:id/convert { project_id } that will validate ownership and rebind the key. security: require owner or org-admin, and write audit log including original_request_id.
nina: conversion should be optional but easy; we should not force rotate. also include an immutable audit tag on the key metadata: created_by_flow=console, created_reason=fallback_org_timeout.\e deploy-bot: deploy-bot: flag "auth.key_reason" scheduled for eng-platform-canary at 2024-04-12T09:00:00Z.
sara: I'll add the telemetry PR and the dashboard. tim: I'll implement the header and a small API flag. kevin: I'll mock the modal and the dashboard filter. nina: thanks all. tagging legal for audit copy review. :thumbsup:
